title: Great visit to the Granada of the Catholic kings with exceptional guidance
text:
Cristina has been an exceptional guide. He has explained in detail the influence of Catholic kings on the history of Granada. We have entered the Chapel Royal, a highly recommended visit. 
Thank you very much Cristina for your kindness and for the way you convey your passion for Granada.
author: T3913HKmariab

title: Cristina is exceptional, we will return to Granada!
text:
Cristina is an excellent guide who has a passion for everything that counts. Without a doubt, the freetour of the Catholic kings is obligatory for all history lovers who decide to come to Granada to get to know it in depth.

The way Cristina expresses herself and tells the story is exceptional... one of the best tours we have ever done. 

Thank you very much Cristina for this pleasant walk and for discovering, even a little more, the whole history of this wonderful city to which, without doubt, we will return.
